title: Scaffold Laravel and the toolchain
acceptance: WHEN composer install --no-interaction runs on a clean checkout THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 and populate vendor/ with laravel/framework, livewire/livewire and pestphp/pest at the versions pinned in blueprint.md §11.
WHEN ./vendor/bin/pint --test runs on the freshly scaffolded tree THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.
WHEN ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 at level 5 over app, config, database, routes.
WHEN ./vendor/bin/pest runs THE SYSTEM SHALL report the scaffold's own default test passing, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
WHEN npm ci && npm run build runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 and write a manifest.json under public/build/.
WHEN php artisan serve starts and a request hits / THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200.
verify: php artisan serve --port=8123 & SERVE_PID=$!; sleep 1; test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8123/)" = 200; kill "$SERVE_PID"

title: Git remote and branch protection on GitHub
acceptance: WHEN bash scripts/github-bootstrap.sh runs against a repository with no remote THE SYSTEM SHALL add origin, push main, and create develop, idempotently.
WHEN bash scripts/github-assert-protection.sh runs THE SYSTEM SHALL confirm main requires the ci status check before merge.
WHEN GITHUB_TOKEN is unset THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 1 with a named error before making any API call.
WHEN git ls-remote origin main runs THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve a commit hash.

title: GitHub Actions CI verified end to end
acceptance: WHEN a commit is pushed to a task/** branch THE SYSTEM SHALL trigger the ci workflow.
WHEN the workflow runs THE SYSTEM SHALL report every job (Pint, PHPStan, Pest, asset build) passing.
WHEN a PR targeting main is opened before ci finishes THE SYSTEM SHALL block merge.
verify: git checkout -b task/00-ci-smoke && git commit --allow-empty -m "chore: trigger ci" && git push origin task/00-ci-smoke
git checkout main && git branch -D task/00-ci-smoke && git push origin --delete task/00-ci-smoke

title: Provision the Debian 13 LXC
acceptance: WHEN infra/provision.sh runs against a fresh Debian 13 LXC THE SYSTEM SHALL leave Nginx, PHP-FPM, PostgreSQL, Redis and supervisor all active (running).
WHEN a TCP probe from outside the LXC targets port 5432 or 6379 THE SYSTEM SHALL fail to connect.
WHEN ufw status is read on the LXC THE SYSTEM SHALL list exactly 22 (restricted), 80, 443 as allowed.
WHEN infra/provision.sh runs a second time on the same LXC THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0 and change nothing.

title: Deploy a hello-world release over HTTPS
acceptance: WHEN infra/deploy.sh runs against the provisioned LXC THE SYSTEM SHALL place a release under $DEPLOY_PATH/releases/, symlink current, and reload Nginx and PHP-FPM.
WHEN curl https://$APP_DOMAIN/ is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 with a valid certificate chain.
WHEN the same request is repeated after a second deploy THE SYSTEM SHALL still respond 200 with zero downtime observed.

title: Core identity and profile schema
acceptance: WHEN php artisan migrate --force runs on an empty database THE SYSTEM SHALL create profiles with every column §4 lists, plus the publishable() macro columns.
WHEN a Profile is saved without a slug THE SYSTEM SHALL fail at the database's not-null constraint.
WHEN Profile::published() is queried on a table with one published and one unpublished row THE SYSTEM SHALL return exactly the published one.
verify: php artisan migrate:rollback --step=1000 --force && php artisan migrate --force

title: Career schema
acceptance: WHEN php artisan migrate --force runs THE SYSTEM SHALL create companies, experiences, education, certifications, skill_categories, skills, technologies with every FK from §4's relationship list.
WHEN a Skill is saved with level=6 THE SYSTEM SHALL fail the database check constraint.
WHEN a Company with a related Experience is deleted THE SYSTEM SHALL fail (restrict), not cascade.
verify: php artisan migrate:rollback --step=1000 --force && php artisan migrate --force

title: Project schema
acceptance: WHEN php artisan migrate --force runs THE SYSTEM SHALL create project_categories, projects, software_projects (unique project_id), project_technologies, and SHALL NOT create project_media or project_documents at this step.
WHEN a Project is deleted THE SYSTEM SHALL cascade-delete its software_projects row and its project_technologies rows.
WHEN a ProjectCategory with a related Project is deleted THE SYSTEM SHALL fail (restrict).
verify: php artisan migrate:rollback --step=1000 --force && php artisan migrate --force

title: Media/document/social/settings/audit/import schema
acceptance: WHEN php artisan migrate --force runs THE SYSTEM SHALL create documents, social_profiles, settings, audit_logs, imports, import_records, and audit_logs SHALL have no deleted_at column.
WHEN two documents rows for the same (profile_id, kind) both set is_current=true THE SYSTEM SHALL fail the partial unique index.
WHEN app()->make(AnalyticsProviderInterface::class) resolves THE SYSTEM SHALL return NullAnalyticsProvider, and calling any of its methods SHALL be a no-op that performs no HTTP call.
WHEN PortfolioIntegration is checked for concrete implementations THE SYSTEM SHALL find zero.
verify: php artisan migrate:rollback --step=1000 --force && php artisan migrate --force

title: Authentication: Fortify and mandatory MFA
acceptance: WHEN a user without two_factor_confirmed_at set requests any /admin/* route THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect to /admin/two-factor-setup.
WHEN 6 login attempts occur within one minute for the same email+IP THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 429 on the 6th.
WHEN a login fails THE SYSTEM SHALL write exactly one audit_logs row with action=login_failed and the request's IP and user agent.
WHEN a login succeeds with TOTP confirmed THE SYSTEM SHALL write exactly one audit_logs row with action=login and update users.last_login_at/last_login_ip.
WHEN the login form is submitted with a wrong password THE SYSTEM SHALL respond with a generic message that does not reveal whether the email exists.

title: Authorization: roles and Policies
acceptance: WHEN php artisan db:seed --class=RoleSeeder --force runs twice THE SYSTEM SHALL leave exactly one super_admin role row both times.
WHEN a user with no role attempts to update a Project THE SYSTEM SHALL be denied by the Policy.
WHEN a user with super_admin attempts the same update THE SYSTEM SHALL be authorized.
WHEN every content model in §4 is checked THE SYSTEM SHALL have exactly 14 registered Policies.

title: Realistic content seeder and factories
acceptance: WHEN php artisan db:seed --force runs on an empty database THE SYSTEM SHALL create exactly 4 companies, 6 experiences, 2 education, 8 certifications, 24 skills, 20 technologies, 9 projects, 4 software_projects, 3 documents, 5 social_profiles.
WHEN php artisan db:seed --force runs a second time THE SYSTEM SHALL leave every count unchanged.
WHEN the seeded admin's two_factor_confirmed_at is read THE SYSTEM SHALL be null.
verify: php artisan migrate:rollback --step=1000 --force && php artisan migrate --force

title: Filament install, panel configuration, MFA gate
acceptance: WHEN an unauthenticated request hits /admin THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect to /admin/login.
WHEN the seeded admin (MFA unconfirmed) logs in THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect to /admin/two-factor-setup before reaching the dashboard.
WHEN APP_ENV=production and /telescope is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 404.
WHEN APP_ENV=local and TELESCOPE_ENABLED=true and /telescope is requested by an authenticated admin THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200.

title: Filament resources, set 1 (profile/company/experience/education/certification)
acceptance: WHEN /admin/profiles, /admin/companies, /admin/experiences, /admin/education, /admin/certifications are requested by an authenticated super_admin THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 and list the seeded rows.
WHEN a record is created through any of these 5 resources THE SYSTEM SHALL persist it with published=false by default.
WHEN a bulk-delete action is invoked THE SYSTEM SHALL soft-delete, never hard-delete.

title: Filament resources, set 2 (projects/software/categories/technologies/skills)
acceptance: WHEN /admin/projects, /admin/project-categories, /admin/technologies, /admin/skills, /admin/skill-categories are requested THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200.
WHEN a Project is edited to attach 3 technologies THE SYSTEM SHALL write exactly 3 project_technologies rows.
WHEN the software-project toggle is enabled and saved with a repository_url THE SYSTEM SHALL create the corresponding software_projects row.

title: Media library and hardened uploads
acceptance: WHEN a file with a .svg extension is uploaded through any Filament media field THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it, regardless of its declared MIME type.
WHEN a renamed-extension file (PNG name, script-bearing bytes) is uploaded THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it via the sniffed MIME check.
WHEN a valid JPEG is uploaded THE SYSTEM SHALL store it on the media_private disk under a generated filename and it SHALL NOT be reachable at a guessable public URL.
WHEN an authenticated non-admin request for /media/{id} targets a media row referenced only by an unpublished project THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 403.
WHEN project_media is queried after this task's migration THE SYSTEM SHALL exist with the (project_id, media_id, sort_order) shape.

title: Documents, social profiles, settings, audit log, dashboard widgets
acceptance: WHEN a Project is updated through Filament THE SYSTEM SHALL write exactly one audit_logs row in the same transaction, with the actor id and a redacted diff.
WHEN /resume/{document} is requested for a published, current resume THE SYSTEM SHALL stream the file and increment download_count by exactly 1, atomically under concurrent requests.
WHEN the audit log viewer is opened THE SYSTEM SHALL show no create/edit/delete action anywhere on the page.
WHEN the dashboard is opened THE SYSTEM SHALL show the published/draft project counts matching a direct database count.

title: Design tokens and base layout
acceptance: WHEN the built CSS is grepped THE SYSTEM SHALL contain zero occurrences of fonts.googleapis.com or fonts.gstatic.com.
WHEN any Blade view is grepped THE SYSTEM SHALL contain zero occurrences of the same two hosts.
WHEN a page loads with the dark preference stored THE SYSTEM SHALL apply data-theme="dark" before the first paint.
WHEN the layout is rendered THE SYSTEM SHALL contain exactly one <h1> and a skip-to-content link as the first focusable element.

title: Component library
acceptance: WHEN /components (local/testing env only) is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL render every listed component with no unstyled element.
WHEN prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is emulated THE SYSTEM SHALL render every reveal target already at its final opacity/position with no transition applied.
WHEN the theme toggle is clicked THE SYSTEM SHALL flip data-theme on <html> and persist the choice to localStorage.

title: Public pages, set 1 (home/about/experience/skills)
acceptance: WHEN /, /about, /experience, /skills are requested THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 and render only published=true rows.
WHEN every experience row is unpublished THE SYSTEM SHALL render the experience page with no timeline section, never a placeholder stub.
WHEN / is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL contain the seeded profile's headline in the rendered server HTML.

title: Public pages, set 2, and the contact form
acceptance: WHEN /projects/{slug} is requested for a published project THE SYSTEM SHALL render its technologies, media gallery and documents.
WHEN /projects/{slug} is requested for an unpublished project THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 404.
WHEN the contact form is submitted with a valid payload and empty honeypot THE SYSTEM SHALL send exactly one mail and write zero database rows.
WHEN the honeypot field is non-empty THE SYSTEM SHALL return the same success state and send zero mail.
WHEN the form is submitted 6 times in one hour from the same IP THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 429 on the 6th.

title: SEO surface
acceptance: WHEN php artisan seo:audit runs over every published route THE SYSTEM SHALL report zero missing titles, zero duplicate meta descriptions, zero canonical mismatches.
WHEN /sitemap.xml is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 and list every published entity's canonical URL, and zero unpublished ones.
WHEN /robots.txt is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 and reference /sitemap.xml.
WHEN a project detail page's HTML is parsed THE SYSTEM SHALL contain one valid CreativeWork JSON-LD block.

WHEN tests/Feature/A11yTest.php runs its DomCrawler sweep over every published route THE SYSTEM SHALL report zero pages with a missing alt, a missing form label, more than one <h1>, or an inline color style.

title: Caching and performance
acceptance: WHEN the same public GET is requested twice THE SYSTEM SHALL serve the second response from Redis without re-querying the database.
WHEN a cached project is published/unpublished/edited THE SYSTEM SHALL invalidate exactly that entity's cache entry.
WHEN bash scripts/lighthouse-gate.sh runs against the home page and one project page THE SYSTEM SHALL report performance >= 95 and SEO >= 95 on both, throttled mobile profile.

title: Hardening, backups and operations
acceptance: WHEN any response is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL carry all 6 security headers with the exact values security.md specifies.
WHEN bash infra/backup/restore-drill.sh runs THE SYSTEM SHALL restore the latest dump into a scratch database and report every production table's row count matching, then drop the scratch database.
WHEN the Horizon worker process is killed THE SYSTEM SHALL be restarted by supervisor and queued jobs SHALL resume processing.
WHEN infra/deploy.sh is grepped THE SYSTEM SHALL contain zero occurrences of migrate:fresh or db:wipe.
WHEN /health is requested with the database and Redis both reachable and no pending migration THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 with status:ok.
